registration_note: Declared 2026-10-12 under amendment 1, before any open-interest data was downloaded and before any event return was computed. Trials after this round: v1 9 + v3 2 = 11 cumulative.

candidates.label: repo hypothesis, not published
candidates.motivation: Forced liquidations sell (buy) regardless of value; when a large price move coincides with a large drop in open interest, positions were closed by force rather than by informed flow, so part of the move should reverse over the following day. Literature (BitMEX liquidation studies; liquidation-cascade preprints) documents cascades and recoveries but no tested trading rule.
candidates.universe: Binance USDT-M perpetuals ranked by mean daily perp quote volume over 2020-10-01..2020-12-31 (computed from 1h klines before the development sample); the top 30 that also have Binance futures metrics files from 2021-01-01; list fixed at that rank, delisted contracts kept
candidates.data: Binance futures 1h klines (perp close, quote volume), 1h mark-price klines, fundingRate, and futures/um/daily/metrics 5-minute sum_open_interest (value in contracts or coin as published; use the same field throughout)
candidates.signal: at each 1h bar close t: r4 = close_t / close_(t-4h) - 1; oi4 = OI_t / OI_(t-4h) - 1 with OI_x = last 5-minute sum_open_interest at or before x; LONG event if r4 <= -0.05 and oi4 <= -0.05; SHORT event if r4 >= +0.05 and oi4 <= -0.05
candidates.trade: enter at close_t in the event direction, exit at the close 24h later; one open position per contract (events while in a position are ignored); notional per trade = 10% of account equity at entry; at most 10 concurrent positions (if more qualify at the same t, take the largest |r4|)
candidates.returns: perp price return + realized funding over (entry, exit], costs 14 bps round trip per trade; daily account returns aggregated by exit day
candidates.null: event null: each real trade is replaced by a trade in the same contract, same direction and same calendar month at a uniformly random 1h close (999 draws, seed 20261012); statistic = mean per-trade gross return

amendments.before: any event or trade return was computed. Data inspected before this amendment (correction recorded 2026-10-12 after review): the universe listing (which metrics files exist per symbol), a 4-day BTCUSDT smoke download, and a few single-day BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT metrics files from 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2026 compared with mark prices only to determine the timestamp convention of sum_open_interest. No price-event or return statistic was computed.
amendments.reason: Binance futures metrics (open interest) are published from 2021-12-01 for every perpetual except BTCUSDT (2020-09-01), so the registered universe ('metrics from 2021-01-01') would contain one contract

changes.universe: same ranking (mean daily perp quote volume 2020-10-01..2020-12-31, computed before the sample) but the metrics requirement becomes 'metrics files from 2021-12-01'; top 30 kept, delisted kept
changes.oi_timing: OI_x = last 5-minute record with create_time <= x - 5 minutes: Binance stamps the snapshot at the interval start from about 2024-03 (verified against mark prices: record T matches the price at T+5m after the change, at T before), so the 5-minute lag is strictly causal in both eras

implementation_notes.thresholds: <= / >= with 1e-12 tolerance; OI_(t-lookback) <= 0 gives no event; lookback perturbation changes both r and oi windows
implementation_notes.positions: a contract is free at its exit close; ties in |r4| to earlier column; max 10 open; skipped events reserve nothing
implementation_notes.account: fixed 0.10 of equity per trade; daily account return = sum over trades exiting that UTC day of 0.10 x side x (price return - funding sum) - 0.10 x 14 bps; a 00:00 exit belongs to the new day; turnover 0.2 per trade for the cost wall
implementation_notes.exits: close at t+hold, else last close in (entry, exit], else flat; funding over (entry, exit] on entry notional; trades exiting beyond the data are dropped and counted
implementation_notes.null: mean per-trade gross over development trades; each trade re-drawn among closes of the same contract and calendar month with a usable exit on or before the development end; seed 20261012; identity reproduces observed
implementation_notes.metrics_data: sum_open_interest in base units; files sorted, exact duplicate rows dropped and counted, conflicting duplicates fail, partial/missing days reported in provenance
implementation_notes.leverage: assess_trade_book: each position's own (entry, exit] mark window; P&L and cost stamped at exit as in the gate accounting
implementation_notes.review_fixes_2026_10_12: before the single run: no entries before 2021-12-01 (BTC OI from 11-30 used only for the lookback); an event needs perp quote volume > 0 in the bar ending t (no trades on post-delisting zero-volume bars), same for G4 candidates; OI rows <= 0 treated as missing; partial metrics days and OI staleness reported (rule unchanged); the runner verifies round2_universe.json (metrics_day 2021-12-01, 30 symbols, 2020-Q4 rank window) and never rebuilds silently; leverage liquidation checks fall back to perp 1h high/low where mark bars are missing; gate daily series zero-filled over the full registered windows; leverage bootstrap uses first-to-last exit day inside validation (edge zeros omitted, slightly conservative)
